insights.one_liner: Beerwulf is a 29-person Amsterdam home draught beer company, founded in 2016, an IND recognised sponsor offering English-language internships.

culture.text: About 29 people in Amsterdam selling home draught beer machines, kegs and bar accessories direct to consumers.
Staff studied at Tilburg, Groningen, Amsterdam, Sheffield and Codam College, in economics, supply chain, business and maths.
Calls itself downright enthusiastic about beer.

open.text: Recognised by the IND as a visa sponsor (Beerwulf B.V.).
All 3 current internships (marketing and finance) in Amsterdam don't require Dutch.
